parties:
Tapati Rani alias Boby Rani ----- Petitioner
Vs.
State represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Jamalpur ----- Respondents
full_judgment:
2. In this case the victim girl Tapati Rani alias Boby Rani is in judicial custody. Challenging such keeping her in judicial custody this writ petition was moved and the petitioner obtained the present Rule. The father of the victim girl Tapan Chandra Datta prayed for custody of his daughter on the ground that she is minor and since his prayer was not allowed till today, he moved this writ petition before this court in habeas corpus nature. The detenu is kept in custody with regared to Islampur PS Case No. 5(4) 97 corresponding to GR 308(2) 97 under section 9 (4a)/14 of the Oppreasion to Women and Children (Special Enactment) Act, 1995. 

 3. It is stated in the application that this victim girl was kidnapped by the accused and an FIR was lodged in Islampur Police Station which was registered as Islampur PS Case No. 5 dated 28-4-97 which afterwards had been registered as GR No. 308 (2) of 1997. In connection with the aforesaid case No. 30-4-97 the Police of Sharishabari Police Station arrested the accused and rescused the victim girl and forwarded both of them to the Magistrate. An application was filed for bail for the victim girl, but the learned Magistrate, instead of allowing the application for bail, sent the victim girl to safe custody and ordered for investigation into the case by the Investigating Officer. There was an order for examination of the victim girl by the Civil Surgeon, but the girl refused to be re-examined. In this case the father stated before the Court that his daughter is minor and Head Mistress of the school also gave a certificate showing that the victim girl is minor.The father of the victim girl prayed for bail as well as custody of the girl, but the learned Magistrate refused it and as a result he moved the learned Sessions Judge and Miscellaneous Case has been started before the learned Sessions Judge for the custody of the girls but till today he is unsuccessful in getting a favourable order from the learned Sessions Judge. From different orders of the learned Sessions Judge it appears that the victim girl is minor. The victim girl was produced before the learned Sessions Judge and he expressed the opinion that seeing the physical appearance of the victim girl as well as the school certificate together with the statement of father it appeared to him that the girl is minor, but even then she was kept in judicial custody.
